entries.label: Tax payable by recipient on a personal cash gift
entries.notes: Canada has no gift tax; no annual cap on tax-free personal gifts.
entries.source_note: CRA ISTFM lists 'most gifts and inheritances' as non-taxable income; corroborated by TaxTips.ca 'no gift tax in Canada'. Employer gifts and employment tips are the taxable exceptions.

entries.label: How a recipient reports a personal cash gift on the T1
entries.notes: No line 13000 (other income) entry; income earned ON the gift afterwards is taxable normally.
entries.source_note: MoneySense: gifted cash not taxable, income generated from it is.

entries.label: Donors accepted by lenders/insurers for gifted down payments
entries.notes: No cap: the full down payment can be gifted from an eligible donor.
entries.source_note: Immediate-family definition corroborated by the CMHC gift-letter form and a lender gift form (parent, grandparent, sibling, child, legal guardian).

entries.label: Gift letter required by lenders for gifted down payments
entries.notes: Core elements: donor/borrower names, relationship, amount, date, non-repayable statement, no third-party-interest statement, signatures, borrower acknowledgement.
entries.source_note: CMHC gift-letter template form; contents corroborated by money.ca and insurer-lender equivalents.

entries.label: Standard bank-statement history lenders review for down payment source
entries.notes: Industry standard, not statute; gifts appear as lump-sum deposits and get extra scrutiny with gift letter + donor statement + transfer proof.
entries.source_note: Corroborated by 2026 mortgage-broker guides (kraftmortgages.ca) and a Sep-2026 mortgage-professional piece; 90-day figure is convention across lenders.

entries.label: Deemed disposition on non-cash gifts of capital property
entries.notes: Gift of shares directly triggers the same gain as selling them first; recipient's cost becomes FMV.
entries.source_note: ITA s.69(1)(b)(ii): non-arm's-length disposition of capital property deemed at fair market value; donor taxed on resulting gain.

entries.label: Capital-gains inclusion rate applied to donor's gain
entries.notes: Cross-reference: capital-gains-2026.json for the full inclusion-rate history.
entries.source_note: 50% inclusion verified 2026-09-28; used in the explainer's Python-verified worked example ($65,000 proceeds, $40,000 ACB -> $3,706.25 donor tax at 29.65% combined Ontario marginal).

entries.label: T1135 specified foreign property cost threshold
entries.notes: Cost of gifted foreign property = FMV at receipt; the gift itself is not taxable income.
entries.source_note: CRA Form T1135 instructions; corroborated by toroaccounting.ca T1135 explainer.
